title: R3 v1: the direction-sufficiency rule r3s against the current rule v2d
held_out_reads_before_this_file: none for r3s: analysis/results/refinement_r3/access_log.jsonl does not exist yet

rule.name: r3s
rule.statement: for every pair the current rule (v2d) leaves fully directed d, keep d iff at least K_MIN of the N resamples give exactly d; else the pair stays linked with its direction open (o-o if any PAG mark was seen for the pair, else undirected). Links never change.
rule.K_MIN_from: smallest k with two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound of k/N above 1/2; fixed by the confidence level, not fitted

development.battery: CausalArena dev split, replicate 0: semantic (23 files, released column order) and formula (12 files, columns permuted); PC, 20 resamples (jobs/bootstrap_replay_ca_dev, jobs/bootstrap_replay_ca_formula_dev). Live dev runs (suite_b1, pass 4b) have contested references: agreement only, not pooled.
development.seen_while_designing: the sweep of K over 8..20 on this battery (a diagnostic of the plurality rule's arrows by resample count came first); K_MIN = 15 was not chosen from it

metrics.wrong_share_removed: 1 - wrong(r3s) / wrong(v2d), pooled over the battery's files
metrics.precision_r3s: right / (right + wrong) of r3s, on true links found
metrics.d_prec_lo: lower end of the 95% cluster-bootstrap interval (2000 resamples, seed 20261031, clusters = files) of precision(r3s) - precision(v2d)
metrics.links_identical: 1 if every file has the same linked pairs under r3s and v2d
metrics.false_link_arrow_share_removed: 1 - arrows on false links(r3s) / arrows on false links(v2d)

predictions.note: the cost side, stated so it cannot be hidden

H3.role: primary held-out; never looked at by anyone
H3.what: CausalArena test split, replicate 1, both families (25 + 25 files); PC wrapper defaults, 20 resamples, seed 0; formula columns permuted with seed 20261012 + crc32(file name)

H1.role: secondary; opened before for other rules (BND-10 read replicate 0 of the test split for v1; BLD-06's data part for v2d on the formula family)

H2.role: secondary; opened before (BND-10, BLD-06); the live bootstrap tables of the 30 S2 tables (labels s2 and f06), the tables the live run reuses
H2.what: runs with label s2 or f06 whose dataset is in datasets/suite_q1s2

decision.adopt_on_branch_if: P3, P4 and P5 SUPPORTED on H3
decision.not_adopted_if: P3 or P4 REFUTED on H3, or P5 not SUPPORTED
decision.otherwise: inconclusive: r3s stays on its branch, unmerged, and a larger battery is proposed
decision.H1_H2: reported beside H3; they cannot overturn it (both were opened before)
decision.one_read: each battery is read once with this rule's composite hash (RULE.json); every read is appended to analysis/results/refinement_r3/access_log.jsonl

regression.case: gas/void, scenario q011, run 20261021T214822Z_f06_q011_r01_dadc44 (BLD-06 branch), pair (14, 15)
regression.check: r3s keeps the pair linked and does not commit void -> gas
regression.role: a regression check only (program v3 section 4 rule 5): never a tuning target, never a threshold

not_claimed: that open directions are right: an open direction is a non-claim, scored as neither right nor wrong
anything about the names part: the data rule is name-blind; the names part on opened pairs is the live run's question (plans/r3_live_proposal.json)
semi-directed marks: passed through unchanged (typed gap)
